spec.query:
FROM security-events
| WHERE event_type == "security_alert"
| STATS alert_count = COUNT(*) BY mitre_tactics
| SORT alert_count DESC

FROM security-events
| WHERE event_type == "security_alert"
| STATS alert_count = COUNT(*) BY mitre_techniques
| SORT alert_count DESC

FROM security-events
| WHERE event_type == "security_alert"
| EVAL response_status = "Not Integrated"
| STATS alert_count = COUNT(*) BY response_status

FROM security-events
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*) BY severity

spec.title: Security Events Detail Table
spec.description: Displays security event records from Elasticsearch for SOC analyst investigation. Current data is synthetic and used for dashboard validation.

spec.query:
FROM security-events
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*) BY host
| SORT event_count DESC

FROM security-events
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*) BY process_name
| SORT event_count DESC

FROM security-events
| STATS event_count = COUNT(*) BY event_type
| SORT event_count DESC

FROM security-events
| KEEP @timestamp, host, process_name, event_type, severity, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-events
| WHERE severity == "high" OR process_name == "suspicious-test-process"
| KEEP @timestamp, host, process_name, severity, event_type, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 20
